text:
Anna Liu: quick sync — need to finalise Q3 GTM targets + PLG experiment slate. Kickoff doc in Drive: https://tinyurl.com/rw-gtm-q3
Kevin Park: propose ARR quota uplift of 18% vs Q2; comps based on pipeline from SMB PLG lead-ins.
Marisol Gomez: sales ok with 18% if enablement has 2 new playbooks and a PLG dashboard by launch.
Jamie Chen: RevOps — need final segment definitions by next Tue. I'll own measurement.
Cleo Ramos: Marketing — campaign windows: week of Jul 6 and Aug 17. Need product collateral + demo video.
Oliver Patel: Product — what's in-scope for the "PLG config" roll? we have bandwidth for one extra minor UI change.
Anna Liu: @Oliver we need: 1) self-serve trial account creation flow, 2) in-app onboarding tooltip, 3) trial-to-paid billing CTA. Can we fit 1+2 as MVP?
Oliver Patel: 1) trial creation: backend done, minor front-end work (2 sprints). 2) onboarding tooltip: design + small infra for event tracking (1 sprint). 3) billing CTA requires finance + legal — not in MVP.
Marisol Gomez: so target is to hit conversion lift in trial cohort; if we can only do 1+2, sales will accept.
Kevin Park: numbers: pipeline motion target = $1.1M new ARR from PLG-sourced accounts; MQL to SQL conversion goal +15%.
Anna Liu: launch criteria checklist (draft):
```
- Trial account creation in prod
- 3 onboarding tooltips live
- PLG dashboard live with cohorting
- Playbook for AE enablement written
- Minimum conversion uplift signal in A/B test
```
Cleo Ramos: also need 2 assets: short demo (90s) and 1-pager for SDRs. Can design and copy by Jul 2 if we freeze scope by Jun 24.
Jamie Chen: blocking: tracking events spec missing. @Oliver can you ping infra?
Oliver Patel: pinged eng-infra channel, will post event spec today.
deploy-bot: Reminder: product deploy freeze starts 2024-07-01 00:00 UTC for major release window.
Anna Liu: ok, action items: @Oliver final scope by EOD Thu, @Jamie segment defs by Tue, @Cleo creatives by Jul 2, @Marisol validate sales acceptance. We'll reconvene Fri 10am to lock numbers.
Kevin Park: +1
Marisol Gomez: thanks, will prep objections list.
Cleo Ramos: adding to calendar invite.
Anna Liu: thanks everyone :rocket:
